definitions.explanation: The upper portion or top area of something. Used in both everyday descriptions and technical contexts to indicate the part that is higher in position.

examples.japanese: ⟦ページ→ページ：02961_peeji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上部|じょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ロゴ→ロゴ：11264_rogo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a logo at the top of the page.

examples.japanese: ⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上部|じょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べた→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧。
examples.english: I lined up books on the upper part of the shelf.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上部|じょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧デッキ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設|もう}けられている→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: An observation deck is installed in the upper part of this building.

notes:
USAGE: {上部|じょうぶ} refers to the physical upper portion of an object, structure, or space. It is somewhat formal and is common in written descriptions, instructions, and technical texts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {上部|じょうぶ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}する→位置する：09891_ichisuru⟧ (to be located in the upper part)
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上部|じょうぶ} (the top of the screen)
- ⟦{胸|むね}→胸：00972_mune⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{上部|じょうぶ} (the upper chest)

NOTE: Do not confuse with ⟦{丈夫|じょうぶ}→丈夫：01156_joubu⟧ (sturdy, durable), which has the same reading but a completely different meaning.

PAIR: The opposite is ⟦{下部|かぶ}→下部：11378_kabu⟧ (lower part).
